top_picks.title: CompMat-Bench: benchmark agents on real computational materials workflows
top_picks.summary: CompMat-Bench packages 94 tasks from computational materials studies, reproduces reference steps in advance, and grades with fixed rules rather than an LLM judge; full-guidance pass rates across three LLM-based agents ranged from 66.0% to 90.4%.
